name: City Council Regular Meeting - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, June 28, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Members of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82492576626
  Webinar ID: 824 9257 6626
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,82492576626# OR +16699009128,,82492576626#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 or +1 669 900 9128 or +1 346 248 7799 US

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of June 14, 2023 City Council Closed Session and Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Presentation of the First City of Westlake Village Kindness Award to Cecilia
  DePippo, White Oak Elementary School Office Manager and Westlake Village
  Resident

2.  Presentation to Philippe Eskandar, Deputy City Manager

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the printed
agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page 1
of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to
the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Chamber of Commerce Report

4.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
 PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  1. PUBLIC HEARING: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 22-004;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2309-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2309-23, determining Planned
  Development Permit No. 22-004 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing an interior
  and exterior remodel and the construction of a new 1,062 square feet addition of
  habitable space to an existing single-family residence located at 4040 Whitesail
  Circle.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2309-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 22-004,
  AUTHORIZING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW 1,062 SQ. FT. ADDITION OF HABITABLE
  SPACE AND AN INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR REMODEL OF AN EXISTING 2,432 SQ. FT. TWO-
  STORY SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE LOCATED AT 4040 WHITESAIL CIRCLE

2.  PUBLIC HEARING: CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 18-007 MODIFICATION
  NO. 1; RESOLUTION NO. 2310-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2310-23, determining
  Conditional Use Permit No. 18-007 is exempt from CEQA and approving
  Modification No. 1 to authorize the continued operation of an auto body repair facility
  within a commercial suite of a business park located at 31131 Via Colinas, Suite
  601.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2310-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING AN EXTENSION OF THE PERMIT TERM FOR CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT NO. 18-007 TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED OPERATION OF AN AUTO BODY
  REPAIR FACILITY WITHIN AN EXISTING BUSINESS PARK LOCATED AT 31131 VIA COLINAS,
  SUITE NO. 601

3.  PUBLIC HEARING: CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 97-004, MODIFICATION
  NO. 3, CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 07-005, MODIFICATION NO. 1, AND
  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 23-001; RESOLUTION NO. 2311-23,
  RESOLUTION NO. 2312-23, AND RESOLUTION NO. 2313-23 - Adopt Resolution
  No. 2311-23, Resolution No. 2312-23, and Resolution No. 2313-23 ‘Resolutions of
  the City Council of the City of Westlake Village determining Conditional Use Permit
  No. 97-004, Conditional Use Permit No. 07-005, and Planned Development Permit
  No. 23-001 are exempt from CEQA and approving Modification No. 3 of Conditional
  Use Permit No. 97-004 and Modification No. 1 of Conditional Use Permit No. 07-005
  to increase maximum enrollment on the middle school campus located at 31829 La
  Tienda Road from 300 to 600 students, add elementary school grades, and revise
  conditions of approval related to traffic management measures’ and approving
  Planned Development Permit No. 23-001 to authorize the installation of seven
  modular classrooms on the middle school campus.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2311-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE DETERMINING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 97-004 IS EXEMPT
  FROM CEQA AND APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 3OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 97-
  004 TO REVISE CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL TO REFLECT EXISTING TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT
  MEASURES OF A PRIVATE HIGH SCHOOL LOCATED AT 31717 LA TIENDA ROAD

  RESOLUTION NO. 2312-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE DETERMINING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 07-005 IS EXEMPT
   FROM CEQA AND APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 1 OF CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 07-
  005 TO INCREASE MAXIMUM ENROLLMENT, ADD ELEMENTARY SCHOOL GRADES, AND
  REVISE CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL FOR A PRIVATE MIDDLE SCHOOL LOCATED AT 31829
  LA TIENDA ROAD

  RESOLUTION NO. 2313-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE DETERMINING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 23-001 IS
  EXEMPT FROM CEQA AND APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 23-001 TO
  AUTHORIZE THE INSTALLATION OF SEVEN MODULAR CLASSROOMS ON THE MIDDLE
  SCHOOL CAMPUS LOCATED AT 31829 LA TIENDA ROAD

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective June 15, 2023 in the amount of
  $ 515,565.09

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION OF THE CIVIC CENTER
  REDWOOD SEALING AND INTERIOR PAINTING PROJECT - Accept
  completion of the Civic Center Redwood Sealing and Interior Painting Project
  and authorize the City Clerk to execute and record a Notice of Completion on
  behalf of the City.

  2. AMENDING PERSONNEL POLICIES IN COMPLIANCE WITH STATE
  LAW; RESOLUTION NO. 2314-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2314-23
  amending the City’s Personnel Policies to ensure compliance and
  consistency with existing law, integrate best practices, update outdated
  sections and codify current practices or recent changes approved by the City
  Council.
  RESOLUTION NO. 2314-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  AMENDING THE CITY'S PERSONNEL POLICIES

  3. APPROVAL OF A THREE-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH CONEJO
  RECREATION AND PARK DISTRICT TO PROVIDE YOUTH AND SENIOR
  SERVICES FOR 2023 THROUGH 2025 – Approve the Youth and Senior
  Services Program Agreement with Conejo Recreation Park District to offer
  senior recreation classes and youth recreation programs for 2023-2025 and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
   4. APPROVAL OF THE SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE MEMORANDUM OF
  UNDERSTANDING FOR A COORDINATED INTEGRATED MONITORING
  PROGRAM IN THE MALIBU CREEK WATERSHED MANAGEMENT AREA
  - Approve the Second Amendment to the Memorandum of Understanding
  with the Malibu Creek Watershed for the administration and cost sharing of
  the Coordinated Integrated Monitoring Program; and authorize the Mayor to
  sign and execute the Second Amendment on behalf of the City.

  5. ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 303-23. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADDING A NEW
  CHAPTER 8.11 TO ARTICLE 8 (BUILDING REGULATIONS; SEWAGE
  AND WASTE) OF THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE
  CONCERNING DEVELOPMENT IMPACT FEES, AND MAKING A
  DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA - Waive the second
  reading and adopt Ordinance No. 303-23.

  ORDINANCE NO. 303-23 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  ADDING A NEW CHAPTER 8.11 TO ARTICLE 8 (BUILDING REGULATIONS; SEWAGE
  AND WASTE) OF THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE CONCERNING
  DEVELOPMENT IMPACT FEES, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION
  UNDER CEQA

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING EXTERIOR COLORS OF
  RESIDENTIAL AND NON-RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS - Direct staff to schedule a
  study session for the City Council to discuss and provide direction on desirable and
  undesirable colors and shades and regulation of colors.

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, June 22, 2023 at 5:15 p.m. on the City’s website and on the
Posting Board at City Hall.
